LESSON: SELF-EXPRESSION

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Self-expression

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Self-expression
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. Use appropriate vocabulary to • Learners could be encouraged to express feelings and emotions in talk about how they feel and be school and at home. appreciated for expressing their
2. Use appropriate vocabulary to feelings and emotions express own needs in school and appropriately. at home. • Learners could be guided to sing

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Self-expression

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Self-expression

Teach
• Focus skill: Use appropriate vocabulary to • Learners could be encouraged to express feelings and emotions in talk about how they feel and be school and at home. appreciated for expressing their.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Self-expression.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Self-expression
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
